credits.title: Reaper Complex
credits.overview: Helena, a recently graduated psychologist, finds her father being taken away by Death – hood, scythe and all, tired of all the bureaucracy of his work. In order to convince the shadowy entity to give up on her father's fate, Helena invites Death to a therapy session.

credits.title: Terra Firme
credits.overview: In a coastal village forgotten by time, young Juca approaches Zé Cangulo, a fisherman living in isolation on his boat. A silent bond forms between them, shaped by waiting and the sea. By bringing to light a submerged past in which the boy recognizes himself, this encounter opens up the possibility of a fresh start.

credits.title: Waltz for Maria Domingas
credits.overview: On the industrial outskirts of São Paulo’s ABC region, Maria Domingas, an exhausted factory worker, breaks away from her routine for the first time: instead of going straight home, she stops at a bar. credits.title: If You Call Me Eveline
credits.overview: A young actress lives with her alcoholic father. One night, she goes to the theatre for a rehearsal of a melodrama play.

credits.title: What happened yesterday?
credits.overview: During a law firm's party, a black man and a white woman are arrested accused of murder.

credits.title: Meias-Verdades
credits.overview: Pedro, distressed for not bidding farewell to his mother, stumbles upon letters addressed to his father, who vanished 30 years ago, unveiling that his life has been a big lie, compelling him to overcome pride to unveil the truth.

credits.title: As The Night Fades
credits.overview: Gabrielle and Leonardo are a young couple used to a complex routine of erotic games. When their relationship enters a crisis, they start to seek new fantasies, each of which are more dangerous and destructive.

credits.title: Mortinho da Silva
credits.overview: During his twin's wake, young Rafa decides, in what appears to be an impulsive act, to steal his brother's coffin and escape in the middle of the night.

credits.overview: Guilherme is tormented by the possibility of his fiancée being cheating on him. Desperate to end this mystery, he plans out a terrible way to finding the truth.
